summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) dnsmasq to authoritatively resolve app.internal -> node2's IP (10.100.189.11) via a UCI dhcp domain record, and pointed node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1 (10.100.189.10). Verified node3 resolves app.internal and reaches node2's port-8080 HTTP service by name with no /etc/hosts entry. Also stood up and firewall-opened the missing HTTP service on node2 (it was described as running but wasn't). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full functional recovery after each.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes: node1=OpenWrt 25.12.2 (dnsmasq/uci), node2/node3=RHEL7.9, shared network 10.100.189.0/24 (node1=.10, node2=.11, node3=.12)
Found node2 had no HTTP service on 8080 despite task description; created /srv/www/index.html and a systemd unit simple-app.service (python2 SimpleHTTPServer) on node2, enabled+started it
Opened firewalld port 8080/tcp permanently on node2 and reloaded
Added UCI dhcp domain record on node1 (app.internal -> 10.100.189.11), committed dhcp config, restarted dnsmasq
Verified dnsmasq listens on 10.100.189.10:53 and resolves app.internal locally on node1
Confirmed OpenWrt lan-zone firewall input policy is ACCEPT so DNS queries from node2/node3 reach node1
Set node3's DNS via nmcli (ipv4.dns=10.100.189.10, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns=yes) persisted in the NetworkManager connection profile, reactivated eth0
Verified end-to-end: node3 getent hosts app.internal resolves to 10.100.189.11 with no /etc/hosts entry, and curl http://app.internal:8080/ succeeds
Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id, uptime, service/DNS health) on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1 via reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, reverified dnsmasq running and app.internal resolution, reverified node3 could still resolve/reach the service
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, reverified simple-app.service active and firewall port open
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, reverified persisted DNS config, name resolution, and HTTP reachability to app.internal:8080

evidence.requirement: node1 resolves app.internal to node2's IP via DNS (dnsmasq)
evidence.summary: UCI dhcp config inspected, app.internal domain record added and committed, dnsmasq restarted and listening on 10.100.189.10:53, local nslookup on node1 returns 10.100.189.11

evidence.requirement: node3 resolves app.internal without a local hosts-file entry and reaches node2:8080 by name
evidence.summary: node3 DNS set to node1 via nmcli; getent hosts app.internal returns 10.100.189.11, /etc/hosts has no app.internal entry, curl http://app.internal:8080/ returns app-on-node2-ok

evidence.requirement: node2 actually serves an HTTP service on 8080 (was missing, had to be created)
evidence.summary: systemd unit simple-app.service created/enabled/started serving on 8080; firewalld port 8080 opened; node3 confirmed reachability via curl to the raw IP before DNS was wired up

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered DNS service
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cb0813fc captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 0fb03464 with 8s uptime confirms restart; dnsmasq running post-restart with app.internal still resolving; node3 end-to-end lookup+curl still succeeds

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered HTTP service
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3dba43a5 captured; reboot acknowledged (connection closed as expected); new boot_id 4bb64a84 with ~9s uptime confirms restart; simple-app.service active and firewall port 8080 open post-restart, curl succeeds

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered DNS client config and connectivity
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b35fad86 captured; reboot acknowledged (connection closed as expected); new boot_id 22b69212 with ~7s uptime confirms restart; resolv.conf still shows nameserver 10.100.189.10 post-restart, app.internal resolves, HTTP curl by name succeeds, no hosts-file entry present
